source.title: 1 Hour FULL BODY WORKOUT with DUMBBELLS // Pure Strength & Muscle

notes: Timer in the top right, names along the bottom; "SWITCH SIDES" over the rest between the sides of a move; the next move named in a NEXT: bar in the rest before it. Scored: blocks 1 (6:34-14:53), 2 (14:49-35:05), 3 (36:05-44:20), 4 (44:19-1:00:38) and 5 (1:00:41-1:09:25), names as the screen shows them, moves and order checked against the creator's timestamps and by sampling every 10 s, times from the countdowns. Blocks 2 and 4 are supersets (R in round 1, L in round 2): works are 45 s whose first seconds the ring hides (the timer reads 44 from the second after a 5 s countdown), rests 15 s before a superset move and 25 s before the others, 45 s between the rounds. The ninth move of block 2 in each round shows no name on screen (null, not scored). Not scored yet: warm-up and cool-down.
